name: adapt-grow-expanding-links
description: A formative learning-sequence stepper whose step buttons are expanding icon-links: each shows an icon at rest and expands its label on hover, keyboard focus and for the current step. Only the current step's activity is shown; Back and Next navigate. Completion, when enabled, is an explicit learner action, never a score and never a SCORM interaction. Extends ComponentModel, stays outside the scoring machinery.
